title: 별빛 중앙우체국의 아침
description: 별 모양 분류 장치와 날개 달린 봉투가 분주히 오가는 마법 중앙우체국에서 수달 배달부와 동료들이 다섯 가지 변화를 찾아냅니다.
theme: 마법 배달부의 하루 — 별빛 중앙우체국 아침 근무
scene: A grand whimsical magical central post office at sunrise, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. Warm honey-gold morning light pours through tall arched windows into a bustling but visually organized hall of polished teal wood, cream stone, antique brass pipes, and suspended mail rails. At upper center, one oversized antique-brass star-shaped magical sorting machine is mounted clearly against a pale wall; its large central five-point star panel is vivid turquoise and unobstructed. At lower center, a broad sorting counter holds one large plum-purple parcel tied with one thick coral-red ribbon and bow. At upper right, exactly one large cream envelope with exactly two clearly separated small white feathered wings flies alone against a simple blue window area. At lower left, the recurring friendly young otter courier wears a deep teal delivery coat and a mustard-yellow peaked courier cap with one oversized round coral-red badge centered on the front. At lower right, one compact burgundy wooden postal cart stands side-on; its nearest large brass-rimmed wheel has one oversized circular cobalt-blue hub clearly visible. Supporting workers may include one friendly mouse clerk and one sleepy pigeon clerk, while blank parcels, plain envelopes, canvas mail sacks, pigeonholes, brass chutes, and tiny sparkles add atmosphere without cluttering the five anchor objects. Keep the turquoise sorting-star panel, red parcel ribbon, two envelope wings, coral cap badge, and blue cart-wheel hub large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, stamps, letters, numbers, addresses, or clock numerals.
style: original premium whimsical European storybook game illustration, cinematic cozy morning lighting, clean expressive ink contours, soft cel shading, gently hand-painted paper texture, polished animated-feature background quality, friendly rounded anthropomorphic animals, crisp object silhouettes, cohesive dawn blue, teal, cream, antique gold, burgundy, mustard yellow, turquoise, coral red, plum purple, and cobalt blue palette, not imitating any specific artist or franchise
changeGuidance: Make only these five changes: 1) change only the large vivid-turquoise central five-point star panel of the upper-center brass sorting machine to bright sunflower yellow while preserving its shape, 2) change only the thick coral-red ribbon and bow on the large plum-purple parcel at the lower-center counter to emerald green, 3) remove exactly one of the two white feathered wings from the single large flying cream envelope at upper right so it has only one wing, 4) change only the oversized round coral-red badge on the front of the lower-left otter courier's mustard-yellow cap into a clearly visible crescent-moon-shaped cobalt-blue badge of similar size, 5) change only the oversized circular cobalt-blue hub of the nearest wheel on the lower-right burgundy postal cart to a five-point-star-shaped golden hub of similar size. Preserve the otter courier, mouse clerk, pigeon clerk, post-office architecture, sorting machine, parcel, envelope, cart, mail sacks, pigeonholes, chutes, camera, crop, lighting, palette, texture, and every other object exactly. Do not make any additional changes.
